description: Nucleoid normalizes imported field labels while retaining their live list
code:
labels = ["first name", "last name", "display name"]
separator = "_"
fields = labels.map(label => label.lower().replaceAll(" ", separator))
assert(fields, ["first_name", "last_name", "display_name"])
separator = "-"
assert(fields, ["first-name", "last-name", "display-name"])
labels.push("account name")
assert(fields, ["first-name", "last-name", "display-name", "account-name"])
assert(labels[0], "first name")

description: Nucleoid inserts template markers at Unicode scalar boundaries
code:
accent = String.fromCharCode(233)
symbol = String.fromCharCode(128512)
name = accent + symbol
marked = name.replaceAll("", "|")
assert(marked, "|" + accent + "|" + symbol + "|")
assert("".replaceAll("", "|"), "|")
assert(name.replaceAll("", ""), name)
name = symbol
assert(marked, "|" + symbol + "|")

description: Nucleoid substitutes template slots without interpreting replacement metacharacters
code:
template = "{name}/{name}"
slash = String.fromCharCode(92)
replacement = "$&" + slash + "1"
rendered = template.replaceAll("{name}", replacement)
assert(rendered, replacement + "/" + replacement)
assert(template, "{name}/{name}")
assert("aaaaa".replaceAll("aa", "X"), "XXa")
replacement = "Ada"
assert(rendered, "Ada/Ada")
rendered

description: Nucleoid derives live URL slugs for text records through a class rule
code:
class Article(title: str):
    this.title = title
$Article.slug = $Article.title.lower().replaceAll(" ", "-")
first = Article("One Two One")
second = Article("Fresh Notes")
slugs = Article.map(article => article.slug)
assert(slugs, ["one-two-one", "fresh-notes"])
first.title = "New Notes"
assert(first.slug, "new-notes")
assert(slugs, ["new-notes", "fresh-notes"])
assert(second.title, "Fresh Notes")

description: Nucleoid freezes a text normalizer definition but keeps its replacement input live
code:
text = "old::notes::today"
separator = "/"
def normalize(value) => value.replaceAll("::", separator)
frozen = normalize.value
live = normalize(text)
saved = frozen(text)
assert(live, "old/notes/today")
assert(saved, "old/notes/today")
def normalize(value) => value.replaceAll("::", "-")
assert(live, "old-notes-today")
separator = "_"
assert(saved, "old_notes_today")
text = "new::notes"
assert(live, "new-notes")
assert(saved, "new_notes")
